parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database to be scaled.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the DRDS instance.

parameters.name: ExpandType
parameters.description:
The scaling type. Valid values:

* **smooth_expand**: smooth scale-out
* **hot_expand**: hotspot update.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The job ID of the scaling task. The value is the same as that of ParentJobId.

parameters.name: ParentJobId
parameters.description: The task ID of the scaling task. This ID is returned when you submit the scaling task request.
